source='''def transform(grid):
    """Stamp the shape of the existing 2 marker wherever it fits on zeros."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 2]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    mask = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    max_r = max(r for r, c in mask)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in mask)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - max_r):
        for c in range(w - max_c):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = 2
    return out
'''
